mapper.insert: insert into pm_task (project_id, requirement_id, creator_id, current_version_id, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) values (#{projectId}, #{requirementId}, #{creatorId}, #{currentVersionId}, #{status}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert into pm_task_version (task_id, version_no, title, description, requirement_version_id, created_by, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{versionNo}, #{title}, #{description}, #{requirementVersionId}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.sql: select t.task_id, t.project_id, t.requirement_id, t.creator_id, t.current_version_id, tv.version_no as task_version_no, tv.title, tv.description, tv.requirement_version_id, rv.version_no as requirement_version_no, case when requirement_record.current_version_id is not null and requirement_record.current_version_id <> tv.requirement_version_id then 1 else 0 end as requirement_version_outdated, t.status, d.dict_label as status_label, t.is_deleted, t.create_time, t.update_time from pm_task t inner join pm_task_version tv on tv.version_id = t.current_version_id inner join pm_requirement_version rv on rv.version_id = tv.requirement_version_id left join pm_requirement requirement_record on requirement_record.requirement_id = t.requirement_id and requirement_record.project_id = t.project_id left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'pm_task_status' and d.dict_value = t.status where 1 = 1
mapper.select: select tv.version_id, tv.task_id, tv.version_no, tv.title, tv.description, tv.requirement_version_id, rv.version_no as requirement_version_no, tv.created_by, tv.create_time, t.is_deleted from pm_task_version tv inner join pm_task t on t.task_id = tv.task_id inner join pm_requirement_version rv on rv.version_id = tv.requirement_version_id where t.project_id = #{projectId} and t.task_id = #{taskId} and exists ( select 1 from pm_project_member access_member where access_member.project_id = t.project_id and access_member.user_id = #{userId} ) order by tv.version_no asc, tv.version_id asc

select c.task_id, c.category_value, d.dict_label as category_label from pm_task_category c left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'pm_task_category' and d.dict_value = c.category_value where c.task_id = #{taskId} order by c.category_value asc
select o.task_id, o.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email from pm_task_owner o inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.user_id where o.task_id = #{taskId} order by o.user_id asc

select dict_code as dictCode, dict_sort as dictSort, dict_label as dictLabel, dict_value as dictValue, dict_type as dictType, css_class as cssClass, list_class as listClass, is_default as isDefault, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from sys_dict_data where dict_type = 'pm_task_status' and status = '0' order by dict_sort asc, dict_code asc

select dict_code as dictCode, dict_sort as dictSort, dict_label as dictLabel, dict_value as dictValue, dict_type as dictType, css_class as cssClass, list_class as listClass, is_default as isDefault, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from sys_dict_data where dict_type = 'pm_task_category' and status = '0' order by dict_sort asc, dict_code asc
